open_issues.impact: Machine-layer hook keys validate and are visible to resolve('harness'), but hooks show/sync and the carrier ignore them.
open_issues.next: Decide later whether machine defaults should be shown separately (e.g. an 'effective' field in hooks-state) or applied by hooks.
open_issues.text: Hook leaves now accept the machine layer, but hooks read only the committed carrier, so machine-layer hook defaults have no effect on running hooks. This is a deliberate effect of 'sync renders only project-file keys'.

open_issues.impact: Carrier content depends only on the project file; relies on aicore resolve deriving the machine file from env/home.
open_issues.next: If aicore gains an explicit 'layers' parameter, switch to it.
open_issues.text: project_settings isolates the machine layer by passing env={} and a nonexistent home path to aicore.config.resolve; env-layer SKM_HARNESS_* variables are likewise ignored for the carrier.

summary: F1 fixed. In config.schema.json every [harness.hooks] leaf (including providers.* overrides) now allows layers defaults, machine, project; policy_profile stays defaults/project. config.example.toml regenerated. hooks_env.project_settings now resolves with an empty machine location, so hooks show/sync and hooks.env use only keys set in the project file and machine defaults are never copied into the committed carrier. settings_audit.read_policy_declaration uses the full resolve and now returns the project policy_profile when a machine hook key exists. In test_hooks_env.py, test_a_machine_layer_key_is_refused is replaced by two tests: a machine-layer hook key plus a project policy_profile makes hooks show succeed and read_policy_declaration return 'base'; sync renders only project-file keys. The layer-pinning schema test was updated. CHANGELOG line adjusted. Targeted runs (tmp HOME/SKM_HOME): tests.test_hooks_env + tests.test_settings_audit (90 OK); tests.test_provider_hooks + tests.test_doctor_settings_cli + tests.test_settings_audit_fieldcase (32 OK, 1 skipped); `aicore config example packages/harness` output equals the committed example.
